tracks.quickwins: A bounded, useful implementation on an existing foundation; confirm it is missing and small before starting.
tracks.stillneeded: Substantial absent or incomplete functionality, including repairs that cannot safely fit a quick win.
tracks.cleanup: Residual exactness, uncommon combinations, refinement and broad qualification after working functional breadth.

selection_rule: Sweep packages once per pass. Finish one bounded quick win, record it, then move to the next package. Do not drain every candidate in a subsystem before moving on.
timebox: At most one normal implementation checkpoint for a quick-win candidate. If investigation shows it needs engine redesign or several increments, preserve findings in stillneeded and move on. Never ship a known data-loss or broken transaction to meet the timebox.
no_quickwin_rule: Packages without an honest small deliverable skip pass1/3 and retain all scope in stillneeded. Candidate wording is not a claim that work is absent, complete or estimated.
dependency_rule: Only dependencies needed for the selected usable path move forward; required API/menu/history/focused tests are in that same increment. Numerical polish and wider combinations wait unless correctness/safety of that path depends on them.
pass_gate: Advance after each package has been swept and every candidate is delivered, already present with evidence, or explicitly reclassified to stillneeded. Full package closure is not a prerequisite for changing passes.
closure_rule: Track delivery is separate from package closure. Original acceptance criteria, exactness, APIs and supported systems must all be met before a full package or goal is closed.
final_phase_rule: Final settings/detail packages retain quickwins/stillneeded/cleanup subtracks inside pass7; work them in that internal order, then run final release checks. Engine preferences needed for a selected path stay with that path.
